ध्रु ध्रवति (श) ध्रुवति 6.
a. To be firm
or fixed; to go or move.

ध्रू (श) ध्रुबति 6.
a. To firm; to go.

ध्रुव् (श) ध्रुवति 6.
a. To stand firm
or fixed; to go or move.

ध्रुव (वः-वा-वं)
a. Fixed, eternal,
certain.
m. Brahmā; Viṣṇu;
Shiva; the polar star.
f. A sa-
crificial vase.
n. Certainty; logic.

ध्रुवक (कः) 1.
m. The trunk of a tree;
longitude.
f. The chorus.
